continuation of breast feeds up to one year of age
effective institution of prevention of parent to child transmission (PPTCT) recommendations
cohort: The abstract discusses children in India at risk of or living with perinatally acquired HIV infection.
finding: Effective institution of prevention of parent to child transmission (PPTCT) recommendations in India has brought down the mother-to-child HIV transmission rate to 5.74%.
